text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While training day by day towards the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, on the other hand—
choice_data_list: (As a Trainer, I need to grow even more!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My task is to build up strength worthy of Buena Vista's true caliber.
While pondering this—
I spotted the Buena Vista "trio."
choice_data_list: (Are those... the other girls from my generation?)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, your stories are always so exciting...
and fun, Nakayama-san!

...Buena Vista-chan.
Famous without even saying it!
A heroine of the academy, beloved by all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, that's what happens when you're always taking risks.
...Wanna give it a try too?

And this is Nakayama Festa-chan.
She has a bit of an outlaw vibe, but she's
a true gambler with a passionate heart.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama, seriously, cut it out, okay?
Buena-chan is totally pure, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Everyone is full of energy
again today, it's so much fun.

"Tosen Jordan-chan! A gal with true grit!
Wonder Acute-san!
She's warm and sweet, just like a grandma~"
choice_data_list: I see... Wait, who have you even been talking to this whole time?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey~.
It's the academy's info broker, Transcend~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You're Buena-chan's
Trainer-chan, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I think you already know, but... including me,
we're all in Buena-chan's class year.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And so, I went ahead and introduced them all at once~.
Well, what do you think? Quite the stellar lineup, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, they all seem pretty talented.
Yeah, everyone seems so talented, huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If there's anyone you're interested in, just let me know.
I wouldn't mind hooking you up with some info~"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know you only care
about Buena-chan, though.
choice_data_list: ...By the way, what kind of thing is it?
...By the way, what kind of thing is it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
Anything you wanna know, just ask away.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Like, finding ways to support Buena-chan, for instance.
—Filling in what's missing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, don't you dare
underestimate an informant.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So with that, feel free to call on me whenever~.
...This sounds like it's gonna be fun♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As her childhood friend, I like to think I know Buena Vista well. But naturally, we haven't spent every moment together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I can understand the parts of her I don't know...
I might find a hint to help her.
And if I do, I might get closer to the state she reaches—"
choice_data_list: (...Maybe I'll rely on them for this.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you made it~
Been waiting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You want to know more
about Buena-chan, right?
choice_data_list: About everyday life at the academy
Buena Vista as Seen by Transcend

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Her day-to-day school life, huh...
Yes, yes, we've gotten plenty of anonymous tips.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, found something interesting.
"Once, when Buena-chan forgot the paper dictionary
she needed for class—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Hearing about it, a crowd of students from other classes came over to lend theirs. For a moment, there was pushing and shoving, and the sounds of dictionaries flying around echoed through the hallway."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "So, is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's see,
speaking of recent events...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Looks like she's really into the cafe's salad bowls. She tries a different dressing every time, apparently."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"According to the friend who went with her,
'It was so cute watching her struggle, forgetting which dressings she hadn't tried yet'... apparently."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "So, is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well... to me, Buena-chan is...
Totally like a real idol, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Going all-in on cuteness! But at the same time,
she's approachable...
and with that inner strength, she's got a cool side too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Like being the center of a mega-idol group?
It really gives off that 'chosen one' vibe, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "So, is there anything else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec. You heard that info, right?
...Ah, don't tell me you've already had enough?
Guess that's a wrap then~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And finally...
A little piece of advice for you, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan's base stats are pretty high.
If you want to stand on equal footing with her,
raising your stats is a must.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In short, you gotta build it up step by step.
Try exploring and learning a wide variety of things.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it all comes down to how hard you worked.
If you wanna handle the unexpected, I definitely recommend steadily building up your fundamentals, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I immediately went to the library to review the basics.
I also read not only the latest training papers, but papers across various fields to learn comprehensively.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On another day, to understand how it feels to be on the receiving end of coaching,
I asked a senior Trainer and tried tackling half a day's worth
of an Umamusume's training regimen myself."

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're not keeping pace!
Your form's falling apart too, stay focused!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice!
Just keep sprinting right past tomorrow and into the day after!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night. After training was over,
I was applying what we'd learned so far to devise
a strategy for the next race, when...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for working so late!
I brought some snacks for you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Late-night snack time! I packed some rice balls
and a few side dishes for you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You haven't had dinner yet, right?
...Let's take a quick break."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hey,
doesn't this feeling seem a little nostalgic?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Studying for the trainer academy entrance exam.
Back then, too, they were working hard and studying late into the night—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. While taking a break,
we chatted about all sorts of silly things."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, even now I still wonder a bit
if maybe I was just intruding back then, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had always watched over her and cared for her.
...Casually and effortlessly, just like right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must be wondering if I'm pushing myself too hard, or strung too tight.
If I'm overworking myself... That's what she's worried about. But—
choice_data_list: I can keep going. I'll be fine
I can keep going. I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list: Because it's what I've been doing all this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nothing has changed since my days taking the training academy entrance exams.
My motivation remains one and the same—and I already know there's no limit to how hard I'll push myself for it.
choice_data_list: I'd do anything to stay by your side.
I'd do anything to stay by your side

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: Will you watch over me for a while?
Will you watch over me for a while?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Got it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I've got so... sooooo many things
I want to say, but...
For now, I'll swallow my words."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You're going to try your best for me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Instead... please let me watch over you by your side for just a little longer today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Because I want to take a good, long look at you as you are right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Buena Vista waited until I finished working.
As we stepped outside the academy to walk her back to the dorm..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, Buena-chan and Trainer-chan... hm?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo~?
I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you cleared the event.
Not bad~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, guess my work here is done?
Ending up as "just friends" would be too sad a consolation, so
keep on working hard without slacking, okay?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Um.
Did something happen with Tran-san?
choice_data_list: ...I was taught all sorts of things, yeah.
...You really taught me a lot of things, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Transcend, I grew a little.
In my heart, I put my hands together in gratitude
toward the departing informant's back...
